{{Top|leg}}
[[Neuro-Saav Corporation]] produced a '''biorecognition package''' for use in [[Droid/Legends|droids]]. [[Arakyd Industries/Legends|Arakyd Industries]]' [[Stiletto security droid]] made use of the package, allowing it to identify a target if its [[Bioscan/Legends|bioscan]] readings were on file.<ref name="CFTD">''[[Cynabar's Fantastic Technology: Droids]]''</ref>
